meta.title: Business Register and Employment Survey: employees by industry
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from a business survey of ~80,000 units, benchmarked to the IDBR; open-access LA figures are rounded (nearest 5 below 100, otherwise to the nearest 250 / 500 / 1,000 depending on size). Includes units registered for PAYE only. Latest year provisional.
meta.limitations: Employee jobs, not people; excludes self-employed (significant in construction) and HM Forces. Location in which the job is recorded can reflect head-office/reporting unit allocation. Rounding means small sectors (e.g. division 93) and year-on-year changes are coarse; location quotients and BEDS totals are computed from rounded counts. 'Retail' is a broad-group subset of section G. Divisions 49 (land transport), 51 (air) and 52 (warehousing) are subsets of section H 'transport' - do not add them to it. Air transport (51) counts airline jobs where the employer's reporting unit sits (e.g. an airline base at Luton Airport); airport operation and ground handling (52.23) fall in warehousing & support (52), and airport retail/security elsewhere.
